children: FMC completed a $403.2 million private equity investment from Tessenderlo Group at $13.30 per share, giving the investor about 20.0% ownership. Concurrently, FMC entered into an Investor Agreement providing Tessenderlo with board nomination and observer rights while it holds at least 10%, along with voting commitments, standstill restrictions, a 36-month lock-up, and preemptive rights to maintain a 20% stake. FMC also signed a Registration Rights Agreement granting eight demand registrations, not more than one every 120 days, with customary expense coverage and indemnities. The agreements set governance, ownership, and future liquidity terms for the long-term partnership.
